Notes

This data element does not indicate that alcohol was a cause of the crash. If a police crash report indicates that opened or unopened alcohol bottles were found in the vehicle, then this information does not by itself constitute involvement. Prior to 2019 the Data Element ID was P16/NM15. From 2019-2021 the Element Data ID was P16/NM16.
